items.summaryEn: Honda has announced an expansion of its North American oil train production, plans to invest $3 billion to build a brand new automotive plant in Ohio, the U.S., and is expected to create more than 2,000 jobs and officially go into production in 2029. The new plant, with an annual production capacity of 240,000 vehicles, will integrate with Honda's existing production facilities in Ohio, Alabama, and Georgia, expanding production of oil-powered hybrid vehicles, engines, and oil-power systems.
